# Pixel Poll

A tiny offline polling app. One question, four options. Click an option to vote, watch the live counts and percentage bars update, change your vote anytime, or reset everything.

## Files

- `index.html` — page structure and accessible labels
- `styles.css` — themed card layout and control states
- `app.js` — voting logic, counts, percentages, reset

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, no network, no dependencies.

## Behavior

- Clicking an option records your vote and highlights your choice.
- Clicking a different option moves your vote (the previous option loses one vote).
- Each option shows its vote count and a percentage bar.
- **Reset votes** returns all options to their starting counts and clears your selection.

## Accessibility

- All controls are native buttons with visible hover, focus and pressed states.
- Options use `aria-pressed` to announce the current selection.
- Percentage bars expose `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`.
- Layout works from 360px wide and uses system fonts at 16px or larger.
